sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ ״דָּמֵי יְדֵי עָלַי״ — שָׁמִין אוֹתוֹ כַּמָּה הוּא שָׁוָה בַּיָּד וּבְלֹא יָד. זֶה חוֹמֶר בַּנְּדָרִים מִבַּעֲרָכִין.

positions.claim: one who vows 'the assessment of my forearm' is appraised for his worth with and without the forearm and pays the difference
this shows vows of assessment are more stringent than valuations, since 'the valuation of my forearm' obligates nothing
